description: This file implements health check registration and handling for a Kubernetes API server, including endpoints for healthz, livez, and readyz, with support for delayed health checks and graceful shutdown signals.

classes.name: healthMux
classes.description: Interface defining the Handle method for registering HTTP handlers.

classes.name: healthCheckRegistry
classes.description: Struct managing health check registration, installation, and delayed checks.

classes.name: delayedLivezCheck
classes.description: Struct wrapping a health check to delay its failure until a specified time.

methods.name: addHealthChecks
methods.description: Adds health checks to the registry with optional delay.

methods.name: addDelayedHealthChecks
methods.description: Adds delayed health checks with a specified delay.

methods.name: installHandler
methods.description: Installs the healthz handler on the server.

methods.name: installHandlerWithHealthyFunc
methods.description: Installs the handler with a callback for first-time health status.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the delayed health check.

methods.name: Check
methods.description: Performs the health check, considering delay.
